description: Development of software for real-world engineering applications using both imperative and object-oriented approaches. Topics include basic algorithms and data structures, abstract data types, generic collection types, design of large programs, using and building software libraries, user interfaces, debugging techniques, software documentation.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of:
    • CSC110 - Fundamentals of Programming I (1.5)
    • CSC111 - Fundamentals of Programming with Engineering Applications (1.5)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 116, CSC 115, CSC 160.
title: Fundamentals of Programming with Engineering Applications II
